scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @valora/contracts run build && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "pnpm --filter @valora/contracts run dev" "pnpm --filter @valora/api run dev" "pnpm --filter @valora/web run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @valora/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @valora/api run build && pnpm --filter @valora/web run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @valora/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @valora/api run typecheck && pnpm --filter @valora/web run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @valora/api run lint && pnpm --filter @valora/web run lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @valora/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @valora/api run test
